skills.name: Align unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, typically the LCD, and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract numerator quantities once denominators are common, keep the denominator, and simplify the resulting fractional value when needed.

skills.name: Manage whole and mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers and mixed numbers as whole-plus-fraction quantities, subtract whole-number parts separately, and recombine whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Regroup by borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
